title: Photoconductor: photocurrent and gain of a uniformly lit n-type bar with two ohmic contacts (analytic)
description:
One n-type silicon bar (N_D = 1e22 1/m^3, n_i 1e16, 4 um long, two 5 nm cells high, SRH lifetime tau_srh for both carriers) with ohmic contacts on the outer 20 nm (anode V_bias = 1 mV on x_lo, cathode 0 V on x_hi), solved by two identical drift_diffusion physics on the same bar: dark without light, lit with a uniform generation G0 = G_tau / tau_srh (generation feature; contact cells generate nothing), so the excess density scale G0 tau_srh = 1e18 = 1e-4 N_D is the same for every lifetime (low injection). The photocurrent dI = I_lit - I_dark is the difference of the two anode scalar outputs, so the dark current and its float32 material rounding cancel. Two physics, not two bars: bars a few nm apart (thinner than the 41 nm Debye length) share the excess electrons electrostatically, so a dark neighbour bar would carry part of the photocurrent. Stationary sweep tau_srh = 1e-10..1e-8 s (hole diffusion length 0.35..3.5 um against L_eff = 3.965 um).
Analytic: the excess pairs (dn = dp, quasi-neutral) vanish at the innermost contact cell centres, L_eff = Lx - 2 w_contact + dx apart: dp = G tau (1 - cosh((x - Lx/2) / L) / cosh(L_eff / (2 L))), L = sqrt(D_p tau), D_p = mu_p V_T. To first order the conductance rises by the mean excess conductivity: dI = q h (V_bias / L_eff) (mu_n + mu_p) G tau [1 - (2 L / L_eff) tanh(L_eff / (2 L))] per m of depth; gain = dI / (q G h L_eff) = (mu_n + mu_p) tau V_bias / L_eff^2 [...] (the lifetime over the transit time). Corrections: low injection ~dp / N_D = 1e-4, drift of the minority holes (E L / (2 V_T))^2 <= 3e-4 at 1 mV (an even effect: the bar is symmetric), Debye length 41 nm << L.
Derived values tab: I_dark (dark anode current = q h (V / L_eff)(mu_n n0 + mu_p p0), exact to ~1e-6), dI_photo and gain against the formulas (tolerance 2e-3), P_mean (mean hole density over the free part of the lit bar) against the averaged cosh profile.
Sweep tab: dI_photo, gain and P_mean versus tau_srh (log axis useful) with their dashed curves: the gain grows as tau until L reaches L_eff / 2, then the contacts sweep the pairs out and dI saturates toward q h (V / L_eff) (mu_n + mu_p) G0 L_eff^2 / (12 D_p).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 1e-9 s): P_profile along the lit bar, the cosh profile between the contacts. Field tab: N, P, generation, recombination, V of lit.

parameters.name: tau_srh
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (the sweep runs 1e-10..1e-8 s)

parameters.name: V_bias
parameters.description: anode voltage of both physics in V (cathodes at 0 V); small, so minority drift stays a second-order effect

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: N_D
parameters.description: donor density of the bar in 1/m^3

parameters.name: G_tau
parameters.description: G0 tau_srh: the excess pair density scale in 1/m^3 (1e-4 N_D)

parameters.name: G0
parameters.description: uniform generation rate of physics lit in 1/(m^3 s)

parameters.name: h_bar
parameters.description: height of the bar = domain height (two cells: a 1D problem)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of each ohmic contact at the bar ends

parameters.name: L_eff
parameters.description: distance between the innermost contact cell centres in m (3.965 um)

parameters.name: L_core
parameters.description: length of the free (non-contact) part of the bar in m

parameters.name: bracket
parameters.description: mean excess density over G tau (contact sweep-out factor)

parameters.name: gain_ref
parameters.description: analytic photoconductive gain dI / (q G0 h L_eff)

parameters.name: P_mean_ref
parameters.description: analytic mean hole density over the free part of the lit bar in 1/m^3
